scoringMethod.description: Scores must be supported by recorded evidence. Missing evidence is not treated as a zero-demand market.

demandEvidence.description: Evidence that people actively search for or need this solution.

problemClarity.description: How clearly the tool solves a specific user problem.

competitionGap.description: Evidence that existing alternatives leave a meaningful gap.

monetizationPotential.description: Evidence that the solution could support a viable business model.

buildFeasibility.description: How practical it is to build and maintain the tool.
